trace.msg: Let's look at this puzzle carefully. I'll only move when I can explain why.
I can't rule out left or down yet, so I'll make an educated guess: left.
Going left, the next 4 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (3,5). So the line goes down.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going right would leave number 3 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going down would force the two-exit cells to link up into a loop (or put the numbers out of order). So my guess (left from number 1) was wrong, so the line must go down.
Number 2 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
I can't rule out up or down yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.
I can't rule out around the edge to (5,2) or left yet, so I'll make an educated guess: around the edge to (5,2).
I can't rule out up or left yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.
I can't rule out left or up yet, so I'll make an educated guess: left.
Going up leaves no safe move afterwards; going around the edge to (4,5), every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So the line goes down.
Going around the edge to (5,5), the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (3,1). So the line goes around the edge to (1,1).
Number 5 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Cell (3,2) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes right.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes right.
Number 7 is only reachable this way.
Number 8 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going around the edge to (5,4) would force the line onto number 11 before its turn. So the line goes right.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes around the edge to (5,5).
Cell (4,5) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes up.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
I grow a search tree: my policy network suggests moves, a trained value head judge them. 40 simulations per move.
One of my simulated futures reached the end after 3 simulations. Following it!
Let evolution do the work: 24 random lines compete, the fittest breed and mutate.

Generation 0: a perfect line evolved! Every cell covered.
Feeling lucky! Before every move I'll play 24 random futures and bet on the move that survives most often.
Jackpot! A future after going down covers the whole board. Cashing in!
